Custom Shopify Functionality

Product personalisation and useful tools designed for the way your business works.

The work

Some products need more than a standard product page. Personalised products, for example, need a clear input flow and a reliable way to carry a customer’s choices into the order.

How we approach it

I map the complete flow before building: inputs, previews, validation, cart data and error states. On mobile, the controls need to remain usable without hiding the product.

Typical scope

  • Product customisers
  • Custom inputs
  • Cart properties
  • Interactive previews
  • Practical testing

Scope and timing are agreed for each project.
